title: The week in photos: November 14-20, 2026
summary: A recap of news, sports, lifestyle, entertainment, and human interest images from the Philippines and around the globe

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Leaders and representatives of ASEAN’s 11 members, including Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, newly reelected Brazil President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, and United States President Donald Trump, arrived in Manila for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.

On November 14, regional leaders signed the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA), the first region-wide agreement of its kind. The milestone established common rules for digital trade and payments. The bloc also advanced initiatives on maritime cooperation, disaster response, online scams, and child protection.
The 49th ASEAN Summit resulted in over a hundred outcome documents but failed to resolve ongoing issues such as the civil war in Myanmar and the South China Sea Code of Conduct negotiations.

“I would say that it was a success simply because of the work that we were able to achieve. The one thing I did not want to do was to waste an opportunity such as this by just doing this hosting,” President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. told the media following the summit’s closing ceremony on November 17.

Meanwhile, activists opposing Pax Silica and US President Donald Trump’s visit gathered on November 15 to protest. Police blocked their march resulting in skirmishes and arrests. Nearly 300 were detained in Manila and Las Pinas City. On November 18, the demonstrators were released due to lack of evidence.
